name: Hiru wa Idol, Yoru wa Ai Dorei! ~Kon'ya no Maiku wa Anata no Seiki~
original_name: 昼はアイドル、夜は愛奴隷！～今夜のマイクはあなたの性器～
source:
An idol singer... I close my eyes and look back the day I first met her. She was singing on TV. Her name is Kurumi. Since then, I've been always thinking about her. She just grabbed my heart. I fell in love with her at first sight. I don't need to be her boyfriend, just wanna stay with her...

[From Eroge Shop]
translation:
偶像歌手……我闭上眼睛，回想起初次见到她的那一天。她正在电视上唱歌，名字叫久留美。从那以后，我始终思念着她。她一下子俘获了我的心，我对她一见钟情。我不奢望成为她的男朋友，只想待在她身边……

[摘自Eroge Shop]
